messages:
sophie: noticing elevated 403s for a handful of customers during weekend deploy. they show up as SCIM PATCH failures with NotAuthorized on KMS rewrap. any recent RBAC/key policy changes?

dan: which key alias and which service principal? can we see the audit diff?

sophie: alias is alias/provisioner-extid-prod. error in logs: `ReEncrypt failed: AccessDeniedException` and the SCIM patch retries then gives 400 because extId becomes empty. timeline: deploy at 1717899000, KMS policy change at 1717900000 per security-bot.

security-bot: audit: KMS policy update 1717900000 removed kms:ReEncrypt for role arn:aws:iam::123:role/provisioner-worker due to least-privilege hardening. Link: https://audit.redwood.internal/kms/1717900000 :warning:

kim: we intended to tighten policy but missed that migrator and provisioner need ReEncrypt for rewrap path. should've gated by condition on encryption-context.

dan: two immediate things: 1) temporary rollback of policy to restore availability, 2) add an entryguard so migrator fails safe (do not write null extId) if rewrap fails. who can rollback?

ops-oncall: I can revert the policy for 30m while we run a canary rewrap against a test tenant. will also add CloudWatch alarm on ReEncrypt AccessDenied to page oncall.

sophie: also seeing RBAC role rename in mapping-service around same time: `devops_admin_v2` -> `devops_admin`. mapping emitted a replace with empty roles for some users (suspect bug). Could be two independent regressions coinciding.

dan: pile-up of changes explains the outage spike. action items: revert KMS policy (ops-oncall), patch migrator to be transactional (kim), add mapping-service guard to avoid emitting empty replace (sophie), run database audit to find users with extId=null and restore from backups.

security-bot: creating incident SEC-2026-065 assigned to @sophie @kim @ops-oncall. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-065 :rotating_light:

ops-oncall: rolling rollback now. will post when canary rewrap completes.

sophie: thanks. will coordinate customer comms after we confirm restore. need postmortem that includes a change window policy: avoid simultaneous KMS policy + mapping mapping rollouts within same 24h for tenants in prod.

dan: agreed. I'll draft the postmortem template and include recommended KMS condition patterns (encryption-context constraints).
